scope: Reconcile agent-created local files with PR74 in the IDE checkout; canonical Gymnasium Mathematics/Physics only. This is not completion of the primary goal or the later whole-PR artifact-consolidation work package.

reconciliationOfTenDifferences.fiveOldGeneratedOutputs: Use the published normal-generator successors; original Root bytes matched the previous PR snapshot.
reconciliationOfTenDifferences.claudeProjector: Preserve main-derived tool preparation plus current prerequisite blockers from PR.
reconciliationOfTenDifferences.fourTrackedPythonCaches: Restore published bytes; generated execution artifacts carry no source change.

method: Compare every visible path by Git mode/blob and SHA256/size.
Check current native M7 read set, current five-subject registry, active code/policy provenance, selected V24 original/history references and explicit remaining-primary checkpoint references.
Verify all535 preservation manifest outer hashes; compare37608 declared own-file entries with published blobs and loose originals.
Inspect original content types without creating a scientific approval or reclassifying unique historical opinions as caches.

Retain exact required original paths even when an identical blob exists elsewhere. Copy five specifically referenced original members byte-exactly, with additive locators; do not import complete historical projection/test archives merely because a preservation manifest mentions them.
Retire only individually enumerated, agent-created, non-versioned process paths outside the retained set. Existing versioned PR/main evidence and immutable releases remain untouched.

archiveContentCatalogue.scope: Content-equality catalogue. Published matches verify exact Git blob SHA1 and SHA256; loose Root catalogue is the exact initial9163 census. No scientific role inferred and no archive member extracted/deleted.

historicalOpinionPolicy: Some excluded archives contain unique historical scientific opinions. They are older/unselected experimental process results with no current, selected or remaining-primary dependency in this bounded audit. Exclusion creates neither a new verdict nor a reconstruction promise. Current selected originals and the concrete unfinished-work originals are retained.
